summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ContextWrapper, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 16 tests to tests/test_progress.py, added the Reading from a file and Reading from a file-like object subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added the CHANGELOG bullet for PR 1759. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Open risks: mypy will likely reject the module-level open call that passes a str mode into the Literal-overloaded Progress.open, and no suppression is permitted for it; the import on Python 3.6.2 and the test results are unverified and need a pytest and mypy run.
